description: xUnit conformance tests that check an implementation's real public types and its System.Text.Json serialization against the declared types.

supports.description: A type id maps to a PascalCase public class in the namespace named by the component's csharp module, which is also the implementation assembly name; a property maps to a PascalCase public property whose JSON member name is the model property name.

string to string, integer to long, number to double, decimal to decimal carried as a JSON string, boolean to bool, date to DateOnly, datetime to DateTimeOffset, uuid to Guid, enum to a string or a C# enum serialized by member name, ref to the referenced class, array to IReadOnlyList<T>.
A required member carries the required modifier or [JsonRequired]; a nullable or optional member is a nullable reference or Nullable<T>; an immutable member is init-only or get-only.
Public type and property presence and CLR type, checked by reflection over the implementation assembly, so a missing type fails its own tests rather than the build.

JSON member names, rejection of a payload missing a required member, rejection of an enum value outside the set under the reject policy, and round trip of a contract-conforming payload, with System.Text.Json and the module's ContractJson.Options when the module defines it, otherwise JsonSerializerDefaults.Web.
An exact decimal keeps its text through a round trip; a floating-point member fails the CLR type check.
The generated test project references the implementation through the MSBuild property LoomImplementationProject, which qualification sets; the generated files name no path.

unsupported.reason: Routines are qualified by the SQL and PowerShell profiles.

tooling.purpose: Builds and runs the generated xUnit project against the implementation assembly.

proofLimits: The tests check public shape and serialization only; business behavior is never generated or asserted.
A pass against a fixture assembly does not qualify a different implementation assembly.

checks.claim: The generated xUnit project builds against the implementation assembly.
The generated xUnit tests pass against the conforming implementation fixture and fail against the violating fixture.
checks.limits: Public shape and serialization subset only.
